title: Ember's Suits
description: A silly mod that adds cards and card related weapons to minecraft! Also garlic bread for some reason.
body:
Suits is a mod that adds cards for RP, OR for practical usage :)

**This mod was made with MCreator!! Thanks for making this mod possible to make.**

The mod includes 15 Cards, 5 of them are "Playable." Right clicking to use them will grant an effect or the sort. Along with these cards I've added 5 unique weapons, 3 with unique enchantments to help them stand out at doing their job. The mod also adds garlic bread- If I'm being honest I let my professionalism slip when adding that one in.

**Cards:**

Basic Cards (Heart, spade, club, diamond)
Don't really do anything. They look nice though and can be used to craft the pride cards.

Royal Cards (Royal heart, royal spade, royal club, royal diamond, and the joker)
The royal cards are playable, letting you use them to grant yourself effects. Heart grants regen, Spade grants haste, club grants momentary absorption(essentially a parry), diamond grants speed, and the joker kinda just ghostifies you.

Joke Cards (Gold Card)
It has an absurdly long name, and is completely useless besides being heavy.

Pride Cards (Prideful Heart, spade, club, diamond, and joker)
Purely cosmetic changes to the existing cards. They represent the following: Transgender Heart, Lesbian Spade, Bisexual Club, Pride/Gay Diamond, and Asexual Joker.

**Weapons:**

Hearth Cane (pride ver. Euphoric Cane)
It's a bonking stick that heals what it bonks! It's a _purely_ support tool.
It's enchantments are **Euphoria** (extend effects) and **Empowering** (Grants strength I)

Spade Blade (pride ver. Lesblade)
It's a fast attacking tool that is also a diamond level shovel alternative. That's it :P

Clover Novas (pride ver. Binovas)
Throwable **high** knockback novas. Low damage high annoyance :3

Glaive of Diamonds (pride ver. Glaive of Pride)
a slow but hard hitting melee. It slows those hit and with it's **Snow Burst** enchantment, makes those killed by it explode via the wind charged effect.

Living Dagger (pride ver. Garlic Spreader)
A fast but weak melee. It has two enchantments of which are exclusive. **Blinding Ink** (blinds those it hits) or **Intoxicating Ink** (Applies Nausea to those it hits). Both effects are a nuisance... to be on the other end of.

**Extras:**

2 Paintings by me ("What is bread?" and "Suits of Honour")

4 banner patterns (Heart, spade, club, diamond)
You can use the cards to get the patterns :)

Baize Block
it's the stuff poker tables are made of. Look it up.

Garlic bread
I little better than bread and removes effects when eaten.

If I forgot anything I'll add it later. Thanks for any support I get on this! It was my first time using MCreator and I think I did okay. (I hate variables)
